subject: website
name: IPLD
summary: The IPLD website, open source (Apache-2.0 or MIT). It is not Level 3: a YouTube player embedded in the page loads Google's code as soon as the page opens, before the reader chooses to play anything. It also loads Google Fonts.

connections.name: YouTube embed (www.youtube.com)
connections.note: A visible player on the page, loaded when it opens.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
